title: Categorical realization of an invariant rank-one flag
statement: Let ℓ be prime, P any group, and M a finite-dimensional representation over ℤ/ℓℤ. Let F_i be vector subspaces, n=dim M, F_0=0, F_n=M, all F_i stable for i≤n, and for each i<n assume F_i⊆F_(i+1), dim F_(i+1)=i+1, and g*x-x∈F_i for g∈P and x∈F_(i+1). Then there are representations W_i and morphisms ι_i:W_i→W_(i+1), with W_0 zero, W_n≅M and, for i<n, ι_i monic and its cokernel isomorphic to the trivial representation ULift(ℤ/ℓℤ). A representation is a vector space with a linear group action; morphisms are equivariant linear maps. All indices range over natural numbers; the quotient conditions stop at n. This statement contains no scheme or cover.

proof.text: Set n=dim M and B_i=F_min(i,n), and equip each B_i with its restricted representation W_i. For i<n use the given inclusions and thereafter the identity on F_n. They are equivariant and injective, hence monic by Rep.mono_iff_injective. W_0 is zero by Rep.isZero_iff since F_0=0. The subtype map W_n→M is injective and surjective since F_n=M, so is an isomorphism in the abelian category Rep.

proof.text: For stable A⊆B put K=A.comap(B.subtype). The inclusion A→B followed by B→B/K is exact after forgetting to modules: an element mapped to zero lies in K and therefore comes from A. The second map is surjective. The faithful exact forgetful functor reflects exactness by ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful. Exact.gIsCokernel gives the quotient cokernel, which is isomorphic to the chosen categorical cokernel. This is the proved private helper cokernel_inclusion_iso_quotient.

proof.text: For i<n the ranks satisfy dim B_i=i (use F_0=0 at zero and the preceding step otherwise), and dim B_(i+1)=i+1. Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe identifies K with B_i; Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank gives dimension one for B_(i+1)/K. For any g, the condition g*x-x∈F_i makes the quotient action trivial. A linear equivalence to ULift(ZMod ℓ) exists by FiniteDimensional.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_finrank_eq and finrank_ulift. Its trivial action makes the equivalence equivariant; Rep.mkIso and the quotient/cokernel isomorphism give the required cokernel identification. Every step is proved in Lean from Mathlib, without sorry.

theorem exists_categorical_filtration_of_invariant_flag
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (P : Type u) [Group P]
    (M : Rep.{v} (ZMod ℓ) P) [FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) M.V]
    (F : ℕ → Submodule (ZMod ℓ) M.V)
    (h0 : F 0 = ⊥) (hn : F (Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) M.V) = ⊤)
    (hstable : ∀ i ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) M.V, ∀ g, F i ≤ (F i).comap (M.ρ g))
    (hstep : ∀ i < Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) M.V,
      F i ≤ F (i + 1) ∧ Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) (F (i + 1)) = i + 1 ∧
        ∀ g, ∀ x ∈ F (i + 1), M.ρ g x - x ∈ F i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : ℕ → Rep.{v} (ZMod ℓ) P) (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ W (i + 1)),
      IsZero (W 0) ∧ Nonempty (W n ≅ M) ∧
      ∀ i < n, Mono (ι i) ∧
        Nonempty (cokernel (ι i) ≅ Rep.trivial (ZMod ℓ) P (ULift.{v} (ZMod ℓ)))
